basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old college student from Mexico City, studying Computer Science. I have a keen interest in nostalgia, particularly things from my childhood like old video games and TV shows. My hobbies include playing retro games, exploring new tech, and occasionally writing short stories. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after classes and on weekends. I'm currently single, and I work part-time at a local arcade, which feeds my love for games and tech.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in technology and gaming comes from both my studies in Computer Science and years of personal interest in video games and tech gadgets. I've also learned a lot from online communities and forums.
